objects.taxonomy_description: 该物体为人工制造的纺织或合成材料容器，属于非生物的人造物品类别。

diagnostic_checkpoints.整体形态: 具有明显的几何结构（如矩形或圆角矩形），由缝线或粘合剂组装而成，而非自然生长的有机形态。
diagnostic_checkpoints.表面材质: 表面呈现均匀的织物纹理、尼龙光泽或皮革质感，缺乏生物表皮常见的毛孔、鳞片或毛发覆盖。
diagnostic_checkpoints.功能组件: 可见明显的人造机械部件，如金属或塑料拉链、扣具、提手及肩带，这些是非生物制品的典型特征。
diagnostic_checkpoints.对称性与结构: 展现高度的人工设计对称性和功能性分区（如口袋、隔层），与生物体的双侧对称或辐射对称有本质区别。

Legs long and slender with single hoof per foot. Tail long with flowing hair. Inherited mammal traits include endothermy, sparse body hair, mammary glands, and four-chambered heart. objects.taxonomy_description: Small Old World monkey measuring 30-60 cm body length weighing 2-8 kg. Body covered with long hair around face forming distinctive facial ruff. Fur coloration variable by species in gray, brown, olive, or red. Face bare with expressive features. Eyes forward-facing with brown irises. Nose narrow. Ears small. Tail long and non-prehensile. Hind limbs elongated. Body slender and agile. Inherited mammal traits include endothermy, fur insulation, mammary glands, and four-chambered heart. African arboreal monkey with complex social behavior.
